technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with volume spike present, but severe bearish momentum (MACD, OBV, CMF negative) and price below key moving averages create high-risk setup with limited confluence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: BKR shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 33 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (12/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member 78+ days ago offers minimal conviction support; no recent news sentiment available to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (394.56), flat yield curve with recession signals, and post-FOMC volatility create severely adverse macro conditions; 33-day earnings adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with stochastic bullish cross and 15x volume spike create classic reversal setup at support (26.86), offering contrarian entry in fear-driven market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe bearish momentum (MACD negative, OBV declining, CMF negative), price below EMA-9/21, no active strategy triggered, VIX crisis regime, and 33-day earnings event risk overwhelm oversold technicals and weak fundamental/sentiment conviction.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI (9-period) with stochastic bullish cross and 15x volume spike create textbook reversal setup at support; contrarian fear-zone opportunity aligns with congressional weak buy signal.
decision.primary_risk: Severe bearish momentum (MACD negative, OBV declining, CMF negative) combined with VIX crisis regime (394.56) and 33-day earnings event risk overwhelm technical oversold conditions; macro environment remains unfavourable.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents see reversal opportunity, but fundamental weakness and macro risk create strong bear case that dominates conviction.
decision.portfolio_note: Zero sector concentration in Energy and no existing BKR position; however, portfolio drawdown at 0% and 100 open positions suggest capital allocation constraints—skip preserves dry powder for higher-conviction setups.
